messages:
Alex G: Heads-up: Cerebras asked for a short preview EAP — NDA, benchmarks, and a synced announcement window. Can we outline next steps? :eyes:
Maya R: Do we have their NDA or our standard? And are we testing Hosted/Dedicated/Private?
Alex G: They sent theirs. Legal will redline. Initial numbers should come from Dedicated but we need Private test coverage too.
Samir P: Proposed bench plan (two phases):
- microbench: p50/p95/p99 latency, steady throughput
- e2e LLM flows: chat + long context token churn
We'll reuse bench harness but need a device profile for their wafer-scale node.
Maya R: Partner wants results within 3 weeks of NDA signature. Is that feasible?
Laura T: Legal update: redline uploaded. Main open item is telemetry consent language. Partner wants telemetry limited to aggregated perf only.
Alex G: Noted. Samir, can you post the minimal command so infra can reserve nodes?
Samir P: Sure, minimal smoke run: 
```
# single perf run on Cerebras EAP node
./bench/run.sh --model=llm-13b --devices=cerebras-ws1 --seq=4096 --batch=4 --duration=900 --out=bench_cerebras_$(date +%s).json
```
Samir P: Full matrix (models, quant variants, seq lengths) will take ~4-8h per config. We'll kick off smoke first.
Maya R: Ops: please reserve 2 Dedicated nodes next Tue/Wed afternoon US-PAC (2x8h).
ops-bot: Reservation created: dedicated-pool-7  Tue 13:00 Tue 21:00 UTC  Wed 13:00 Wed 21:00 UTC. Claim by @samir_p within 24h or auto-cancel.
Samir P: Claimed. I'll push device profile + test image by EOD.
Jin (Cerebras): Thanks. Two asks from our side: (1) telemetry limited to aggregated perf only, (2) embargo on raw numbers until joint QA + 14 days.
Maya R: Laura, is that embargo acceptable? We also need co-approval on PR content.
Laura T: Aggregated perf is fine. I'll add explicit press-embargo and co-approval clauses to the countersign and send back.
Alex G: Marketing: we want a joint blog + public benchmark dashboard. Embargo timing must align with marketplace release cadence. @Priya_M please advise.
Priya M: Marketplace sync is Friday cadence. If embargo lifts on Mon we can announce the following Friday. Recommend at least one customer reference or early adopter quote.
Samir P: Bench details to lock down:
- models: gpt-3.5-like, llm-13b
- metrics: p50/p95/p99, tokens/sec, cost-per-token (our infra calc)
- data: anonymized eval-10k prompts
- reproducibility: commit hashes + bench config + seed in repo
Maya R: Partner requests a short SI reference integration (1-hr tech review + terraform snippet). @Rory_S can Solutions Eng produce a minimal module?
Rory S: Yes  I'll draft a tiny terraform module + runbook and aim for 4 days.
Samir P: Also: Cerebras will provide weights in their format. We need a conversion script and a CI job to validate model loading. I'll open a PR after first run.
Alex G: Risks: NDA delays, telemetry negotiation, apples-to-apples bench mismatch. I'll create a lightweight checklist and tracking doc.
ops-bot: Document created: https://redwood.doc/s/cerebras-preview-playbook
Maya R: Please add any absolute blockers to the doc. I'll sync with Jin tomorrow 10am PT to align on observability hooks and diagnostics.
Jin (Cerebras): Confirmed  we'll have an engineer on the call and remote diagnostics ready.
Laura T: Once countersign is done, I'll send the signed NDA to vault and tag ops for access.
Alex G: Target: NDA signed by Friday, first bench run the following week, and if all goes well, co-blog + marketplace listing ~3 weeks after runs. :rocket:
Maya R: Keeping this thread as the single source of truth for the EAP. Ping me for schedule shifts.
